description: He is on Romans 8:28 and asks to read Calvin on it: the request carries the digest of his shelf for this place (Calvin's commentaries, which cover Romans, and a count of the rest), and the answer carries ONE link of kind work to calvin-commentaries with a reference in Romans 8.

request.greek: καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν, τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν.
request.english: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are the called according to His purpose.
request.question: What does Calvin make of this verse? I would like to read him on it in my own copy.
